mode.title: Mode
mode.description: victims = one row per claimed victim. groups = profiles of the ransomware groups themselves. summary = claim counts by group, country or sector so you can see who is most active.

country.title: Country (optional)
country.description: Two letter country code such as US, GB, DE. Leave empty for all countries.

sector.title: Sector (optional)
sector.description: Sector name as the source spells it, for example Healthcare, Manufacturing, Technology, Financial Services. Leave empty for all sectors.

group.title: Ransomware group (optional)
group.description: Filter to one group by name, for example lockbit or safepay. Partial names match.

year.title: Year (optional)
year.description: With month, pulls the claims posted in that calendar month instead of the most recent ones.

daysBack.title: Days back
daysBack.description: How recent a claim has to be to be returned. Records the source publishes without a date are kept rather than silently dropped.

maxRows.title: Max rows per run
maxRows.description: Cap on rows returned. Controls total cost.
